text: Civil law issues of Smart Contracts: Focusing on the DAO case presents the following source proposition: 닉 사보(Nick Szabo)에 의해 창안된 스마트 컨트랙트(Smart Contract) 개념은 당사자들의 합의를 자동화된 절차에 의하여 이행되도록 하는 기술적 방법을 의미한다. This proposition is pertinent to Kaal's source-bound claim that Because smart contracts are coded for computer programming rather than for a human observer, courts may not be able to hypothesize a reasonable human's interpretation of a given smart contract. The proposed response is an extension: the relationship should remain limited to the retrieved source proposition and the mapped Kaal claim unless fuller source review supports a broader conclusion.
